operational_readiness.summary: Usable locally on one Windows host: goals for convert, merge and inventory-diff through the console; the learning loop ran once on one real workload and ties a scripted baseline (mechanism, not advantage); trusted local scope, not production-approved; Level A not accepted, Level B untested; the owner later raised the project spending ceiling from $120 to $220 (25 Nov) and $400 (26 Nov).

No cooperative recipe beat the incumbent in 63 pilot runs; contract v2 fixed spec defects; hosted Nemotron passed 4/4 sealed finals on the two capabilities local gpt-oss-20b could not learn (local 2/4); hosted finals admitted in a test store only, reuse on an unseen release VERIFIED with 0 model calls.
